title: Component Creation Uses Wizard Answers
summary: Component creation must use the current schema and answers wizard flow instead of obsolete one-shot create commands.
agent_instruction: When creating a Greentic component, capture the component schema, create a reviewed answers.json file, run the wizard with --answers, then run component QA. Do not use remembered component create shortcuts.
human_summary: The authoritative component creation path is schema and answers driven.

new_capabilities.title: Component Answers Flow
new_capabilities.summary: Components are generated from a checked answers.json file that matches the current wizard schema.

deprecated_commands.reason: The shorthand command does not capture the current schema-backed answers contract.
One-shot creation hides the answers file that agents and reviewers need.

replaced_guidance.old_guidance: Create components with a one-shot create command.
replaced_guidance.replacement_guidance: Capture the schema, write answers.json, apply the wizard answers flow, then run component QA.
replaced_guidance.reason: The schema-backed answers file is the reviewable contract for current component creation.

migration_steps.instruction: Apply a reviewed answers.json file through the wizard.
